data.title: Jaguar LAA, Inc. Announces Acquisition of Assets Related to the Laminar Program
data.description: Jaguar LAA, Inc. has recently completed a transaction aimed at propelling the advancement of the Laminar program, which focuses on left atrial appendage closure for individuals suffering from non-valvular atrial fibrillation. This Santa Rosa-based company finalized the transaction on September 11, 2026. The company's innovative approach has attracted attention, highlighting its potential to significantly impact patients with this condition. Jaguar's forward trajectory in this area aligns with its commitment to providing effective solutions for those affected by non-valvular atrial fibrillation.
